description: Two customised Canadian Internet Use Survey tables describe digital-service use. The 2009 table includes access location, connection type, frequency/intensity and online activities across Canada, Alberta and listed subprovincial geographies. The 2012 table reports household home-internet access with confidence intervals and coefficients of variation for Canada, Alberta economic regions and metropolitan-influence zones. Both list XLS workbooks. Survey reference periods cover the preceding twelve months, while exact field schemas remain unstated. These are distinct survey-cycle summaries, not measured broadband speed or network topology. The separate household broadband table uses the Survey of Household Spending and remains distinct. The CUDC source records name the Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs, present file access and numerical contents are unverified. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless identified above. No workbook, document or linked data body was fetched. Geographic coverage is Canada and the named Alberta regional subdivisions.
